description_en: Retrieves slow log details for Simple Database Service
description_zh: 查询轻量数据库慢日志明细信息
kebab_example: aliyun swas-open describe-database-slow-log-records --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --database-instance-id db-38263fa955774501a2ae1bdaed6f0000 --start-time 2022-09-07T04:04:44Z --end-time 2022-09-08T04:04:44Z --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDatabaseSlowLogRecords

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the lightweight database instance.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/189315.html operation to get the latest list of supported Alibaba Cloud regions
parameters.help_zh:
指定的轻量数据库实例所属的地域ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/189315.html查看支持的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the lightweight database instance
parameters.name: database_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The page number.

Starting value: 1.

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
轻量数据库实例慢日志列表的页码。

起始值：1。

默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page. Valid values: 30 to 100.

Default value: 30
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时设置的每页行数。取值范围：30~100。

最大值：100。

默认值：30
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The beginning of the time range to query.

The time is in UTC and must be formatted as `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ` as specified by the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25696.html standard.

The console displays this time in the UTC+8 time zone
parameters.help_zh:
查询慢日志起始时间。

按照https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25696.html标准表示，并使用UTC+0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。

+8小时后是控制台上显示的到期时间
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query. The end time must be later than the start time. The interval between the start time and the end time cannot be longer than 7 days.

The time is in UTC and must be formatted as `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ` as specified by the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25696.html standard.

The console displays this time in the UTC+8 time zone
parameters.help_zh:
查询轻量数据库实例慢日志的截止时间。截止时间需要大于查询起始时间，且与查询开始时间间隔小于7天。

按照https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25696.html标准表示，并使用UTC+0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。

+8小时后是控制台上显示的到期时间
parameters.name: end_time

PageNumber.description_en:
The page number of the returned page.

Starts from 1.

Default value: 1
PageNumber.description_zh:
轻量数据库实例慢日志列表的页码。

起始值：1。

默认值：1

PageSize.description_en:
The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: 30 to 100.

Default value: 30
PageSize.description_zh:
分页查询时设置的每页行数。可能值：30~100。

最大值：100。

默认值：30

ExecutionStartTime.description_en:
The start time of the execution. The time is displayed in UTC and is in the `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ` format.

The time displayed in the console is in the UTC+8 time zone, which is 8 hours later than the time in UTC
ExecutionStartTime.description_zh:
执行开始时间。按照[ISO 8601]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25696.html）标准表示，并使用UTC+0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。

+8小时后是控制台上显示的到期时间

HostAddress.description_en: The IP address of the client that is used to connect to the database
HostAddress.description_zh: 连接数据库的客户端名称及地址

SQLText.description_en: The details of the SQL statement

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of slow query logs
TotalCount.description_zh: 轻量数据库服务实例慢日志的总条数
